text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (May 29, 2025) for 1501 Woodbine Avenue, 1406.

The Property Standards Committee – Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (May 29, 2025) for 1501 Woodbine Avenue, 1406, Folder Number 25 164970 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to August 31, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
